description: This file defines the 'OrderType' class, representing different types of orders in the OpenMRS healthcare software. It includes metadata annotations for persistence, fields for identification and relationships, constructors, and methods for class behavior.

classes.name: OrderType
classes.description: Represents various types of orders, such as drug orders, test orders, and referral orders, with properties like class name, parent type, and associated concept classes. It manages persistence via JPA annotations, handles hierarchical relationships, and provides utility methods for class loading and concept class management.
